_meta.category: Historical Cycles -- Repeating Human Nature Patterns
_meta.description: Historical events that repeat the same human nature patterns across centuries. Proof that human nature is the one constant -- greed, fear, hubris, denial cycle endlessly.
_meta.usage: Each entry connects past to present with data. Use for scenario simulation, decision-making, pattern recognition.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Speculative mania driven by narrative over fundamentals
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Dutch tulip bulb prices rose 20x in months. A single Semper Augustus bulb sold for 10,000 guilders -- 10x a skilled craftsman's annual income. Market collapsed in February 1637 within days.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + herd behavior + FOMO
financial_bubbles.outcome: Prices dropped 99%. Many merchants bankrupted. Economy disrupted for years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: NFT market 2021-2022 -- digital assets with no intrinsic value reaching millions
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Bored Ape Yacht Club NFTs fell from $429K average to under $50K by 2023 -- 88% drop
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Price is not value. Scarcity alone does not create worth.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Government-backed speculation creates false confidence
financial_bubbles.what_happened: South Sea Company stock rose 800% in months on promises of trade monopoly with South America. Isaac Newton lost 20,000 pounds. Parliament members were bribed with free shares.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + authority bias + corruption
financial_bubbles.outcome: Stock collapsed from 1,000 to 100 pounds. National financial crisis. Directors imprisoned.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Government-endorsed crypto projects and state-backed digital currencies with inflated promises
financial_bubbles.modern_data: El Salvador's Bitcoin gamble: bought 2,381 BTC, lost ~$60M by 2023 before partial recovery
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Government endorsement does not equal sound investment.

financial_bubbles.pattern: New technology creates irrational expectations of infinite growth
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 272 railway companies authorized by Parliament in 1846 alone. Investment reached one-third of GDP. Most lines were unprofitable or never built.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Technological optimism + greed + herd behavior
financial_bubbles.outcome: Share prices collapsed. Thousands of middle-class families ruined. One-third of authorized railways never built.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: AI startup boom 2023-2025 -- thousands of AI companies, most with no viable business model
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 90% of AI startups expected to fail by 2026 per McKinsey. 85% of AI pilots fail to move to production.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Revolutionary technology does not guarantee every company using it will succeed.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Easy credit + land speculation + mass psychology
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Florida land prices rose 10x. Binder boys flipped lots sight-unseen. Land 20 miles from Miami sold as beachfront. Miami hurricane of 1926 ended the mania.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + willful ignorance + speculation fever
financial_bubbles.outcome: Banks failed across Florida. Precursor to 1929 crash. Towns that boomed became ghost towns.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Dubai property bubble 2023-2024, metaverse land speculation 2021-2022
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Decentraland virtual land dropped 90% from peak. Dubai off-plan sales 60%+ of total market in 2024.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Land value requires real demand, not just speculation.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Leverage amplifies both gains and catastrophic losses
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Dow rose 500% in 8 years. Margin buying let investors borrow 90% of stock value. Black Tuesday Oct 29 saw 16M shares dumped. Market lost 89% peak to trough by 1932.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + leverage addiction + denial
financial_bubbles.outcome: Great Depression. 25% unemployment. 11,000 banks failed. GDP halved. Recovery took 25 years for Dow.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Retail traders using leverage on Robinhood, crypto leverage trading
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 80% of retail traders lose money (ESMA). Crypto leverage liquidations: $2.3B in 24h during May 2021 crash.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Leverage is a weapon that fires in both directions.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Asset prices disconnect from economic reality
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Imperial Palace grounds in Tokyo valued more than all real estate in California. Nikkei hit 38,957. Property and stocks rose 3-5x in 5 years on cheap credit.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: National pride + easy money + herd behavior
financial_bubbles.outcome: Nikkei lost 80% over 13 years. Japan entered 'Lost Decades' of deflation. Nikkei didn't recover to 1989 levels until 2024 -- 34 years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: China property bubble -- Evergrande collapse 2021, ongoing deflation risks
financial_bubbles.modern_data: China property sales down 50% from peak. Evergrande $300B in debt. Youth unemployment 21%+ in 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: National exceptionalism doesn't exempt you from economic gravity.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Story > Substance in speculative markets
financial_bubbles.what_happened: NASDAQ rose 400%. Companies with no revenue valued at billions. Pets.com raised $82M, burned through it in 268 days. 'Eyeballs' replaced revenue as a metric.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Technological optimism + greed + suspension of financial logic
financial_bubbles.outcome: NASDAQ lost 78%. $5 trillion in market value destroyed. 52% of dot-com companies ceased to exist.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: AI companies valued at billions with no revenue path. Unprofitable tech IPOs 2020-2021.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 75% of 2021 IPOs trading below offer price by 2023. WeWork from $47B valuation to bankruptcy.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Revenue matters. Growth without profit is just expensive failure.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Financial engineering obscures real risk
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Banks bundled subprime mortgages into CDOs rated AAA. US home prices rose 124% from 1997-2006. NINJA loans (No Income, No Job, No Assets) became common.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + complexity as camouflage + misaligned incentives
financial_bubbles.outcome: Lehman Brothers collapsed. $10T in global wealth destroyed. 8.7M jobs lost. Taxpayers bailed out banks $700B+.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: DeFi lending protocols with opaque risk. BNPL debt accumulation among young consumers.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: BNPL delinquencies rose 50% in 2023. US credit card debt hit $1.13 trillion in 2024.
financial_bubbles.data_source: Federal Reserve, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau 2024
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: If you can't explain how the money is made, you don't understand the risk.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Retail FOMO creates the final surge before crash
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bitcoin rose from $1,000 to $19,783 in one year. ICO mania raised $6.2B, 80% of which were scams or failures. 'Bitcoin millionaire' entered mainstream vocabulary.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: FOMO + greed + technological mystique
financial_bubbles.outcome: Bitcoin dropped 84% to $3,200. ICO market collapsed. Regulatory crackdowns worldwide.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Meme coin mania 2024-2025 (PEPE, WIF, TRUMP coin)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 97% of meme coins go to zero within 12 months. Average crypto holder holds for 9 months.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: The masses arrive at the top, not the bottom.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Free money creates artificial demand and moral hazard
financial_bubbles.what_happened: $5 trillion in US stimulus. Zero interest rates. Retail trading exploded -- Robinhood added 10M accounts. Meme stocks (GME, AMC) and crypto went parabolic. SPACs raised $160B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Free money illusion + boredom + herd behavior
financial_bubbles.outcome: Inflation hit 9.1%. Fed raised rates fastest in 40 years. Crypto winter. SPAC values collapsed 70-90%.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Government spending continues to grow. US deficit $1.7T in 2023.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 70% of SPACs trading below $5 by 2023. ARK Innovation ETF down 75% from peak.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Stimulus creates temporary highs, not permanent wealth.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Leveraged retail meets institutional exit
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Total crypto market cap hit $3 trillion. Bitcoin reached $69,000. 300+ million crypto users globally. Celebrities promoted tokens.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + social proof + celebrity authority bias
financial_bubbles.outcome: Market lost $2 trillion. Luna/Terra collapsed ($60B wiped). FTX fraud exposed. Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi bankrupt.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Celebrity-promoted tokens continue (Trump coin, Argentine president's token 2025)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Kim Kardashian fined $1.26M for crypto promotion. 46% of crypto tokens launched in 2022 no longer exist.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: If a celebrity is selling it, you're the product.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Artificial scarcity of digital items creates collectible mania
financial_bubbles.what_happened: NFT market volume hit $25B in 2021. Beeple sold digital art for $69M. Profile picture projects reached six-figure floor prices. Wash trading inflated volumes.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Status signaling + FOMO + greater fool theory
financial_bubbles.outcome: NFT trading volume dropped 97% by 2023. 95% of NFTs have zero market value. OpenSea valuation cut from $13B to $1.4B.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Digital collectibles continue but market is 95%+ down
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 23M NFT holders own assets worth $0. Average NFT lost 92% of value.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Digital scarcity is not the same as digital value.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Speculation on future earnings with no current profits
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 613 SPACs raised $162B in 2021. Blank-check companies took unprofitable businesses public. Chamath Palihapitiya became 'SPAC King'. Projections replaced financials.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + regulatory arbitrage + narrative over numbers
financial_bubbles.outcome: Average SPAC lost 50%+ post-merger. Many companies delisted. SEC tightened SPAC rules in 2024.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Pre-revenue AI companies going public or raising at extreme valuations
financial_bubbles.modern_data: De-SPAC companies: median return -65% from merger price by 2023
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: A shortcut to going public is not a shortcut to profitability.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Exotic financial instruments that nobody fully understands
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Hedge fund run by Nobel Prize winners leveraged $4.7B into $125B in positions. Russian debt crisis triggered losses. Fed orchestrated $3.6B bailout to prevent systemic collapse.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Intellectual arrogance + over-leverage + model overconfidence
financial_bubbles.outcome: Near-systemic collapse. Partners lost everything. Lessons about leverage ignored for 10 years until 2008.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Archegos Capital implosion 2021 -- $20B in losses from hidden leverage
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Bill Hwang (Archegos) leveraged $10B into $160B exposure. Banks lost $10B+ combined.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: The smartest people in the room still can't predict black swans.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Penny stock mania driven by social media hype
financial_bubbles.what_happened: GameStop rose 1,500% in weeks driven by Reddit's WallStreetBets. AMC, BB, NOK followed. Robinhood restricted buying, causing outrage. Congressional hearings followed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Rebellion + herd behavior + FOMO + David vs Goliath narrative
financial_bubbles.outcome: Most retail buyers who entered at peaks lost 50-80%. Roaring Kitty faced SEC scrutiny. Retail enthusiasm faded.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Social media pump-and-dumps continue. Trump coin, Argentina LIBRA token.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 80% of GameStop retail buyers who bought above $200 were underwater within 6 months
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Movements need exit strategies. Being right about corruption doesn't make you profitable.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Contagion -- one failure triggers cascade
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Thai baht collapse spread to Indonesia, South Korea, Malaysia, Philippines. Hot money fled. IMF bailouts totaled $118B. Indonesian rupiah lost 80% of value.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Herd behavior + contagion fear + capital flight
financial_bubbles.outcome: GDP collapsed across Southeast Asia. Suharto regime fell in Indonesia. Recovery took 5-10 years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Crypto contagion: Luna collapse triggered Celsius, Voyager, Three Arrows, FTX chain reaction
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 3AC collapse caused $3B in creditor losses. Domino effect wiped $1T from crypto market.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Interconnected systems fail together.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Agricultural commodity speculation with real-world hunger consequences
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Oil prices quadrupled after OPEC embargo. Gold went from $35 to $850. Silver to $50 (Hunt brothers tried to corner market). Inflation hit 14%.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Fear + greed + inflation panic + hoarding
financial_bubbles.outcome: Volcker raised rates to 20%. Deep recession 1981-82. Silver crashed 80%. Hunt brothers bankrupted.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: 2022 commodity spike post-Ukraine invasion. Oil, wheat, fertilizer prices surged.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Global food prices rose 30% in 2022. 349M people in acute food insecurity.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Commodity speculation has human costs measured in hunger and death.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Private market valuations detached from reality
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 1,000+ private companies valued at $1B+. WeWork valued at $47B with massive losses. Vision Fund invested $100B, much of it destroyed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Status signaling + FOMO among VCs + growth-at-all-costs mentality
financial_bubbles.outcome: WeWork: $47B to bankruptcy. Vision Fund lost $27B in 2022. Mass layoffs across tech.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: AI unicorns raising at 100x revenue multiples in 2024-2025
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Down rounds increased 25% in 2023. 54% of unicorns from 2021 worth less than last funding round.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Private valuation is not the same as real value.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Emerging market debt cycles repeat with new creditors
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Mexico defaulted on $80B in debt. Brazil, Argentina, Chile followed. Banks had lent petrodollars recklessly. US banks exposed to 250% of capital.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed (lending) + desperation (borrowing) + short-term thinking
financial_bubbles.outcome: Lost Decade for Latin America. GDP per capita didn't recover for 10 years. IMF austerity caused social unrest.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: China's Belt and Road lending creating similar debt traps in Africa, Sri Lanka
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 60% of low-income countries in or near debt distress (2024). Sri Lanka defaulted 2022.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Lending to those who can't repay is not generosity -- it's imperialism.

financial_bubbles.pattern: The 'this time is different' illusion
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Consumer credit invented at scale. Installment buying made luxury accessible. 60% of cars, 80% of radios bought on credit. Stock market margin buying at 10:1.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Optimism + debt normalization + 'prosperity is permanent' belief
financial_bubbles.outcome: Great Depression. Consumer spending collapsed. Debt deflation spiral.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: BNPL explosion. Klarna, Afterpay, Affirm normalize debt for Gen Z.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: BNPL usage up 400% since 2020. 42% of BNPL users have missed a payment.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Easy credit feels like wealth. It's actually future poverty.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Mining rushes create infrastructure but destroy most participants
financial_bubbles.what_happened: John Law's Mississippi Company promised French colonial riches. Share price rose 20x. Law essentially controlled France's money supply. Simultaneous with South Sea Bubble.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + national pride + monetary manipulation
financial_bubbles.outcome: French economy devastated. Law fled France. Paper money became distrusted for a century.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Stablecoin collapses (Terra/Luna). Central bank digital currency debates.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Terra/Luna: $60B to $0 in 72 hours. Tether still questioned on reserves.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Monetary experiments with other people's money end in tears.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Retail investors buy what they know and love, not what's profitable
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Canada legalized cannabis. Tilray hit $300/share (from $17 IPO). Industry valued at $150B+ on $10B actual sales. Retail investors piled in on 'inevitable' growth.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Narrative bias + extrapolation + retail enthusiasm
financial_bubbles.outcome: Tilray dropped 95%. Canopy Growth lost 99% of peak value. Most cannabis companies unprofitable.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Psychedelic stock bubble 2021. Any 'inevitable legalization' narrative.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Cannabis ETF (MJ) down 85% from 2021 peak. Industry still not profitable at aggregate level.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Legal doesn't mean profitable. Inevitable doesn't mean now.

financial_bubbles.pattern: The same cycle compressed into shorter timeframes each iteration
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bitcoin halvings (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024) each preceded bull runs. Pattern: halving -> bull run -> mania -> crash -> bear market -> repeat. Each cycle bigger.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Pattern recognition + self-fulfilling prophecy + greed recycling
financial_bubbles.outcome: Each peak higher but each crash wipes out those who entered late. 80%+ drawdowns each cycle.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: 2024-2025 cycle playing out post-April 2024 halving
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Each cycle: 80% of new entrants during mania phase lose money within 18 months
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Knowing the pattern doesn't prevent falling for it.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Yield-seeking behavior in low interest rate environments
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 1,043 S&L institutions failed. Deregulation let them take risky bets. Total cost: $160B ($132B from taxpayers). Biggest bailout until 2008.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Moral hazard + deregulation euphoria + yield chasing
financial_bubbles.outcome: Taxpayer bailout. Stricter regulations. Many executives jailed (unlike 2008).
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Silicon Valley Bank 2023 -- same pattern of duration risk in rising rate environment
financial_bubbles.modern_data: SVB held $91B in held-to-maturity securities. Lost $1.8B on fire sale. Triggered bank run in hours via Twitter.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Interest rate risk doesn't disappear because rates have been low for a while.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Innovation cycle: infrastructure overbuilding precedes profitable use
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 50+ telegraph companies formed simultaneously. Massive overbuilding of lines. Most companies failed. Western Union eventually dominated via consolidation.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: First-mover fallacy + technology optimism + winner-take-all blindness
financial_bubbles.outcome: Most companies failed. Infrastructure survived and was consolidated. Western Union monopoly.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Fiber optic overbuilding 1990s. 5G tower buildout 2020s. AI infrastructure spending 2024-2025.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Big Tech AI capex: $200B+ in 2024. Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta combined. Returns still uncertain.
financial_bubbles.data_source: Company earnings reports, Goldman Sachs AI Research 2024
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Infrastructure gets built, but builders rarely profit. Users do.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Insider selling signals the top before retail notices
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Enron executives sold $1.1B in stock while promoting the company. Ken Lay sold $70M while telling employees to buy. Employees lost $1.2B in retirement savings.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Information asymmetry + trust exploitation + self-preservation
financial_bubbles.outcome: Enron bankrupt. 20,000 jobs lost. Arthur Andersen dissolved. Sarbanes-Oxley Act passed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: FTX insiders moved funds before collapse. Tech CEO stock sales at 2021 peaks.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: CEO insider selling hit record $69B in 2021 -- the market top. Zuckerberg sold $4.5B, Bezos $8.9B.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Watch what leaders do, not what they say.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Small country financial experiments become cautionary tales
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Iceland's 3 banks grew assets to 10x GDP. Tiny fishing nation became 'financial center'. Banks collapsed simultaneously. Currency dropped 50%.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: National pride + financial hubris + concentration risk
financial_bubbles.outcome: All 3 banks nationalized. Iceland's GDP fell 10%. Bankers actually prosecuted (unlike US/UK).
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Singapore/Dubai as crypto hubs. Small nations betting on financial innovation.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Dubai attracted 1,800+ crypto firms in 2023. Concentration risk if crypto market crashes.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Punching above your weight in finance means falling harder.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Junk bonds enabling overleveraged buyouts
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Michael Milken created $200B junk bond market. KKR's RJR Nabisco buyout at $25B. Corporate raiders loaded companies with debt. Milken earned $550M in one year.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + financial engineering worship + leverage addiction
financial_bubbles.outcome: Milken jailed. Drexel Burnham bankrupt. Many LBO targets collapsed under debt. S&L crisis amplified.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Private equity loading companies with debt. Leveraged loans at $1.4T in 2024.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: PE-backed company bankruptcy rate 10x higher than non-PE peers in 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Debt-funded acquisitions transfer risk from buyers to workers and creditors.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Currency pegs break under speculative pressure
financial_bubbles.cycle_name: Black Wednesday -- Soros Breaks the Bank of England
financial_bubbles.what_happened: George Soros shorted $10B against the British pound. Bank of England spent $27B defending the peg. Pound fell 15% in one day. UK left the ERM.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Political pride + market forces vs institutional stubbornness
financial_bubbles.outcome: UK lost $3.3B. Soros made $1B in a day. Long-term: UK economy actually improved after devaluation.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Yen weakness 2022-2024. Bank of Japan defending currency with interventions.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Japan spent $62B defending yen in 2022. Yen still fell 30% over 3 years.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Markets are bigger than governments.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Commodity super-cycle creates and destroys nations
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Oil dropped from $115 to $26 per barrel. US shale disrupted OPEC's pricing power. Oil-dependent nations (Venezuela, Nigeria, Russia) devastated.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Resource dependency + complacency + failure to diversify
financial_bubbles.outcome: Venezuela hyperinflation. Russian recession. Norwegian sovereign wealth fund proved diversification works.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Countries betting on single commodities: lithium (Chile), cobalt (Congo), rare earths (China)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Venezuela inflation hit 1,000,000% by 2018. Norway's fund reached $1.7T by 2024.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank, Norges Bank Investment Management
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Resource wealth without diversification is a curse, not a blessing.

financial_bubbles.pattern: New financial product seems safe until it isn't
financial_bubbles.cycle_name: Money Market Fund Breaking the Buck
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Reserve Primary Fund held Lehman Brothers debt. When Lehman collapsed, fund 'broke the buck' -- shares fell below $1. $300B in redemptions across industry in days.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Complacency + assumed safety + contagion fear
financial_bubbles.outcome: Government guaranteed money market funds temporarily. New regulations. Illusion of safety shattered.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Stablecoins promising $1 peg. UST/Terra broke the peg in 2022.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: UST depegged and lost 99.9% of value. $18B destroyed in days.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: 'Safe' financial products are safe until the one time they're not.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Retail investors discover options and leverage near market tops
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 0DTE (zero days to expiration) options volume reached 50% of total S&P 500 options. Retail traders using them as lottery tickets. $1T+ notional daily volume.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Gambling disguised as investing + instant gratification + leverage addiction
financial_bubbles.outcome: Ongoing. Structural market risk. Flash crashes more likely. Most retail 0DTE traders losing.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This IS the modern instance. Pattern matches 1929 bucket shops.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 90% of 0DTE options expire worthless. Average retail options trader loses 1-3% per month.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Making trading easier and cheaper doesn't make traders more profitable.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Political leader ties personal brand to stock market performance
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Trade war tweets moved markets billions. S&P 500 swung 2-5% on single tweets. Markets learned to trade the tweets rather than fundamentals.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Political power games + market manipulation + uncertainty amplification
financial_bubbles.outcome: Increased volatility. Markets priced in political risk. Companies stockpiled before tariffs.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: 2025 tariff announcements creating same pattern with more leverage in system
financial_bubbles.modern_data: VIX spikes 20-40% on tariff announcements. $5T+ in market cap swings on policy tweets.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Markets hate uncertainty more than bad news.

financial_bubbles.pattern: DeFi recreates every failure of traditional finance, faster
financial_bubbles.what_happened: DeFi TVL went from $1B to $180B. Yield farming offered 1000%+ APY. Protocols built on protocols built on protocols. Terra/Luna promised 20% 'stable' yield.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Yield chasing + complexity worship + 'this time it's different via code'
financial_bubbles.outcome: TVL crashed to $40B. Terra/Luna $60B collapse. Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi bankrupt. $2T destroyed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Restaking protocols 2024 offering recursive yield on ETH. Same yield-stacking risk.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Total DeFi hacks: $5.8B from 2020-2024. Average hack: $15M.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Decentralized doesn't mean de-risked. Code doesn't eliminate human greed.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Country-level cryptocurrency adoption driven by desperation, not innovation
financial_bubbles.what_happened: President Bukele made Bitcoin legal tender. Government bought 2,381 BTC. Chivo wallet launched with $30 bonus per user. IMF warned repeatedly.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Political populism + technological solutionism + gambling with public funds
financial_bubbles.outcome: Chivo wallet adoption dropped 80% after initial bonus spent. Tourism briefly boosted. IMF deal required scaling back Bitcoin ambitions.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Other countries considering crypto legal tender (Central African Republic tried, reversed)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Only 12% of Salvadorans still use Bitcoin for transactions. Remittances via Bitcoin: 1.5% of total.
financial_bubbles.data_source: NBER, Central Reserve Bank of El Salvador, IMF
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Technology cannot solve institutional and economic problems alone.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Market euphoria makes simple math invisible
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Shanghai Composite doubled in 12 months. 40M new brokerage accounts opened. Margin debt tripled. Government encouraged participation. Farmers and taxi drivers trading on leverage.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Government-manufactured confidence + FOMO + financial illiteracy + leverage
financial_bubbles.outcome: Market lost 40% in 2 months. $5T in value destroyed. Government froze selling, arrested short sellers.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Chinese property market encouraging buying through nationalism. India retail trading boom 2023-2024.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: India added 100M demat accounts in 3 years. F&O retail losses: $5.4B in FY24 per SEBI.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When governments encourage speculation, the crash is political too.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Confidence in systems grows until a single point of failure reveals fragility
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Nick Leeson, a single rogue trader in Singapore, lost $1.3B through unauthorized trades. 233-year-old bank -- oldest merchant bank in London -- collapsed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Overconfidence in controls + single point of failure + cover-up spiral
financial_bubbles.outcome: Barings sold for 1 pound to ING. Leeson imprisoned. Risk management industry created.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: SBF/FTX -- single person controlling billions with no oversight. Societe Generale's Kerviel.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: FTX: $8B in customer funds misappropriated by one man's decisions. Kerviel: 4.9B euro loss.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: No institution is too old or too respected to be destroyed by one person's unchecked power.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Margin calls create forced selling cascades
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Dow Jones fell 22.6% in one day -- largest single-day percentage drop ever. Portfolio insurance (automated selling) amplified the crash. $500B in market value lost.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Algorithmic amplification + panic + false sense of insurance
financial_bubbles.outcome: Circuit breakers invented. Markets recovered within 2 years. But the speed of collapse shocked everyone.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Algorithmic trading now 60-73% of US equity volume. Flash crashes in 2010, 2015.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 2010 Flash Crash: Dow dropped 1,000 points in minutes. HFT firms now trade in microseconds.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Automating human panic doesn't eliminate it -- it accelerates it.

financial_bubbles.pattern: The biggest profits come right before the biggest collapses
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bear Stearns earned record $2.1B in 2006. Subprime hedge funds collapsed June 2007. Stock went from $170 to $2 in 12 months. Sold to JPMorgan for $10/share.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Hubris + short-termism + dancing while the music plays
financial_bubbles.outcome: 17,000 employees. 85-year-old firm. Gone in a week. First major domino of 2008 crisis.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: FTX reported $1B profit in 2021. Celsius paid 18% yield weeks before collapse.
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Median time from peak profit to bankruptcy for financial firms in crisis: 18 months
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Record profits at a financial firm should trigger investigation, not celebration.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Commodity speculation driven by supply fears
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Speculators attempted to corner the cocoa market in Amsterdam, buying up futures contracts and physical stocks. When the corner failed, prices crashed 60% in weeks.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + market manipulation + overconfidence
financial_bubbles.outcome: Major trading houses went bankrupt. Amsterdam exchange implemented new trading limits.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Nickel squeeze on LME in 2022 when prices doubled in hours
financial_bubbles.modern_data: LME nickel prices jumped 250% in 24 hours in March 2022, forcing exchange to cancel $3.9B in trades
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Cornering markets creates fragile systems that snap violently.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Emerging market debt euphoria followed by default cascade
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Banks lent $327B to Latin American countries in the 1970s. Mexico defaulted in August 1982. Brazil, Argentina, Venezuela followed. 27 countries rescheduled debt.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + willful ignorance + herd lending
financial_bubbles.outcome: Lost decade for Latin America. GDP per capita fell 10%. 9 of top 10 US banks had exposure exceeding their capital.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Emerging market debt crisis 2020-2023, Sri Lanka default 2022
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Sri Lanka defaulted on $51B debt in 2022. Zambia, Ghana, Ethiopia also defaulted 2020-2023.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank, IMF Global Financial Stability Report 2023
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Lending to governments with no repayment capacity always ends the same way.

financial_bubbles.pattern: New financial instrument creates false sense of risk elimination
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Banks packaged subprime mortgages into CDOs rated AAA. $2.5T in CDOs outstanding by 2007. When housing prices fell 30%, the entire structure collapsed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + complexity as camouflage + moral hazard
financial_bubbles.outcome: $10T in global wealth destroyed. 8.7M jobs lost in US alone. 500+ banks failed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: DeFi yield farming 2020-2022 with similarly opaque risk layers
financial_bubbles.modern_data: DeFi total value locked fell from $180B peak to $40B. Terra/Luna collapse wiped $60B in 48 hours.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Complexity does not eliminate risk — it hides it until it's too late.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Central bank easy money inflates asset prices beyond fundamentals
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Federal Reserve balance sheet grew from $900B to $9T. Near-zero rates for 13 years. Every asset class inflated: stocks, bonds, real estate, crypto.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Moral hazard + TINA (There Is No Alternative) + complacency
financial_bubbles.outcome: When rates rose in 2022, $18T in global bond losses. SVB collapsed. Crypto winter wiped $2T.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This IS the modern version — the largest monetary experiment in history
financial_bubbles.modern_data: S&P 500 fell 25% in 2022. 30-year mortgage rates doubled from 3% to 7%. Bitcoin fell 77%.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Free money creates addiction. Withdrawal always causes pain.

financial_bubbles.pattern: National property obsession detached from income reality
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Irish house prices rose 350% in a decade. Construction reached 25% of GDP — highest in the developed world. Banks lent 100%+ mortgages freely.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: National mania + identity tied to property ownership + bank recklessness
financial_bubbles.outcome: Prices fell 55%. National bailout cost €64B (40% of GDP). Emigration surged — 400,000 left.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Canadian and Australian housing bubbles 2020-2024
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Canada house price-to-income ratio hit 10x by 2022 (vs historical 3-4x). Australia hit 9x.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When property becomes a national religion, the correction becomes a national trauma.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Financial innovation outpaces regulatory understanding
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Nick Leeson, a 28-year-old trader in Singapore, accumulated $1.3B in unauthorized derivatives positions. Barings, Britain's oldest merchant bank (233 years), collapsed in days.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Overconfidence + lack of oversight + doubling down on losses
financial_bubbles.outcome: Barings sold for £1 to ING. Singapore's oldest British institution destroyed by one rogue trader.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: FTX collapse 2022 — Sam Bankman-Fried's $32B exchange collapsed due to unauthorized use of customer funds
financial_bubbles.modern_data: FTX lost $8B in customer deposits. SBF convicted of fraud. Alameda's hidden losses totaled $10B.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: One person with too much power and no oversight can destroy centuries of trust.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Currency peg creates false stability until sudden collapse
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Thailand's baht peg broke on July 2, 1997. Contagion spread to Indonesia (rupiah fell 80%), South Korea, Malaysia, Philippines. IMF bailouts totaled $118B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Overconfidence in fixed exchange rates + hot money + crony capitalism
financial_bubbles.outcome: Indonesian GDP contracted 13.5%. 50 million Indonesians pushed below poverty line. Suharto regime fell.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Turkey's lira crisis 2021-2023, Argentina's peso collapse
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Turkish lira lost 80% of value 2021-2023. Argentina inflation hit 211% in 2023.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank, IMF, Central Bank of Turkey
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Pegging a currency to reality you cannot sustain is a time bomb.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Retail investors pile into momentum trades at the worst time
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Shanghai Composite rose 150% in 12 months. 40 million new brokerage accounts opened in Q1 2015 alone. Many borrowed on margin. Market crashed 45% in 3 months.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: FOMO + herd behavior + naive optimism
financial_bubbles.outcome: $5T in market value erased. Government spent $480B trying to prop up markets. Circuit breakers failed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Robinhood retail trading frenzy 2020-2021
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Robinhood added 10M new accounts in 2020. 56% of users were first-time investors. Median account $240.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When taxi drivers give stock tips, it's time to sell.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Emerging technology stocks valued on dreams, not revenue
financial_bubbles.what_happened: NASDAQ peaked at 5,132 on March 10, 2000. Pets.com raised $82.5M in IPO, went bankrupt in 268 days. Webvan burned $375M. 52% of dot-com companies ceased to exist by 2004.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Irrational exuberance + narrative investing + greed
financial_bubbles.outcome: NASDAQ fell 78% to 1,108 by October 2002. $5T in market value destroyed. Recovery took 15 years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: SPAC bubble 2020-2021 — blank check companies valued on promises
financial_bubbles.modern_data: 75% of SPACs from 2020-2021 traded below $10 NAV by 2023. Average SPAC return: -40%.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Revenue matters. Eventually.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Agricultural speculation ruins small farmers
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Cotton prices were manipulated by speculators in New York and London. Small Southern farmers took on debt to expand production. When the bubble burst, cotton prices fell 50%.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + exploitation of information asymmetry + debt trap
financial_bubbles.outcome: Panic of 1837: 40% of banks failed. 6 years of depression. Small farmers dispossessed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Coffee futures speculation affecting small farmers in Colombia and Ethiopia
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Small coffee farmers receive 1-2% of retail price. Coffee futures volatility increased 40% 2020-2023.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank Commodity Markets, Fairtrade Foundation
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Those who speculate and those who produce are rarely the same people.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Sovereign wealth tied to single commodity creates boom-bust
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Venezuela had world's largest proven oil reserves. Oil revenue was 95% of export earnings. When oil prices fell from $115 to $28 (2014-2016), the economy collapsed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Resource curse + corruption + short-term thinking
financial_bubbles.outcome: GDP contracted 75% by 2020. Inflation hit 130,000% in 2018. 7.7M refugees fled the country.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Russia's economic vulnerability after oil price collapse and sanctions 2022
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Russia lost 40% of oil export revenue after EU sanctions. Ruble initially fell 50% before capital controls.
financial_bubbles.data_source: OPEC, UN Refugee Agency, World Bank
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Single-commodity economies are gambling with national survival.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Contagion from one market to globally interconnected system
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Greece revealed its deficit was 12.7% of GDP, not 3.7%. Greek 10-year bond yields hit 35%. Contagion spread to Portugal, Ireland, Spain, Italy. EU bailouts totaled €500B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Denial + creative accounting + systemic interconnection
financial_bubbles.outcome: Greek GDP fell 25%. Youth unemployment hit 55%. Troika austerity imposed for a decade.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Potential EU debt crisis from post-COVID spending, Italy's 140% debt-to-GDP
financial_bubbles.modern_data: EU public debt hit €13.3T in 2023. Italy debt-to-GDP: 140%. France: 112%.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: In a connected system, one country's lie becomes everyone's crisis.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Speculative excess in precious metals driven by fear
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Nelson and William Hunt tried to corner the silver market. Silver prices rose from $6 to $50/oz. They accumulated $6.6B in silver. COMEX changed margin rules. Silver crashed to $10.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + market manipulation + inflation fear
financial_bubbles.outcome: Hunts lost $1B in a single day (Silver Thursday). Eventually declared bankruptcy with $2.5B in debts.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Reddit WallStreetBets silver squeeze attempt 2021
financial_bubbles.modern_data: r/WallStreetBets silver push moved prices 10% briefly in Feb 2021 before collapsing.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: You cannot sustainably corner a commodity market — exchanges will change the rules.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Housing bubble fueled by belief that prices never fall
financial_bubbles.what_happened: US home prices rose 124% from 1997-2006. Subprime mortgages grew from 8% to 20% of originations. NINJA loans (No Income No Job or Assets) became common.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + normalcy bias + financial illiteracy
financial_bubbles.outcome: Home prices fell 33% nationally. 3.8M foreclosures in 2010 alone. 9.3M Americans lost homes.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Post-COVID housing bubble 2020-2022 with prices up 45% in 2 years
financial_bubbles.modern_data: US median home price hit $413K in 2022, up from $285K in 2020. Affordability at worst level since 1981.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Homes are not investments — they are shelter. Treating them as speculative assets creates crises.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Exotic financial products sold to unsophisticated buyers
financial_bubbles.what_happened: German banks sold €120B in Lehman Brothers structured notes to retail customers. When Lehman collapsed, notes became worthless. Average German retiree lost €30K.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Trust in institutions + financial illiteracy + yield chasing
financial_bubbles.outcome: Consumer trust in banks collapsed. Lawsuits totaled €4B. Regulatory overhaul of retail financial products.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Crypto yield products (BlockFi, Celsius, Voyager) sold to retail 2020-2022
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Celsius lost $4.7B of customer funds. BlockFi had $10B in deposits. Voyager: $5.9B.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: If you don't understand the product, you ARE the product.

financial_bubbles.pattern: National savings wiped out by currency collapse
financial_bubbles.what_happened: German mark went from 90 marks per dollar in 1921 to 4.2 trillion per dollar by November 1923. A loaf of bread cost 200 billion marks. Life savings became worthless overnight.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Government desperation + printing money + loss of trust
financial_bubbles.outcome: Middle class destroyed. Social order collapsed. Rise of extremism. Currency reset required.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Zimbabwe 2008 (79.6B% monthly inflation), Venezuela 2018 (130,000% annual), Lebanon 2020-2023
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Lebanese lira lost 98% of value 2019-2023. 80% of population pushed into poverty.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank, Central Bank of Lebanon
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When governments print money without constraint, savings evaporate.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Crypto exchange operated without real reserves
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Mt. Gox handled 70% of all Bitcoin transactions. 850,000 BTC disappeared (worth $450M at the time, $55B at 2024 prices). CEO Mark Karpeles claimed hacking.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Blind trust + centralization risk + lack of transparency
financial_bubbles.outcome: Bitcoin price crashed 50%. Creditors waited 10 years for partial recovery. Trust in crypto exchanges shattered.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: FTX collapse 2022 — same pattern of commingling funds and lack of reserves
financial_bubbles.modern_data: FTX had $8B hole in customer funds. Only 10-25% recovery expected for creditors.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Not your keys, not your coins. Centralized exchanges replicate the bank risks crypto was supposed to eliminate.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Government-created financial instrument becomes weapon of mass destruction
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 1,043 out of 3,234 S&L associations failed. Deregulation allowed them to invest in risky assets. Total cost to taxpayers: $132B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Moral hazard + regulatory capture + corruption
financial_bubbles.outcome: Taxpayer bailout. 1,000+ industry insiders convicted. Real estate markets crashed in multiple states.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Regional bank crisis 2023 (SVB, Signature, First Republic)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: SVB lost $1.8B selling bonds. $42B withdrawn in 24 hours. First Republic lost $100B in deposits.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Government insurance creates moral hazard — protected entities take outsized risks.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Speculative bubble in commodity with genuine supply constraints
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Uranium spot price rose from $7/lb to $138/lb driven by supply fears after Cigar Lake mine flood. Junior mining stocks rose 10-50x. When supply fears eased, price collapsed to $40.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Supply fear + FOMO + speculative fervor
financial_bubbles.outcome: Junior miners lost 80-95% of value. Investors who bought at the top waited 15+ years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Lithium price bubble 2021-2023 driven by EV narrative
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Lithium carbonate fell from $80K/ton to $10K/ton (87% drop) by late 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Even real supply constraints get priced to extremes.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Art and collectibles become speculative assets during easy money
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Japanese companies spent $3.2B on Western art in 1989-90. Ryoei Saito paid $160.5M for van Gogh and Renoir paintings. When the bubble burst, art values fell 50%+.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Status seeking + excess liquidity + cultural trophy hunting
financial_bubbles.outcome: Many artworks quietly resold at massive losses. Art as collateral for loans created cascading defaults.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: NFT art bubble 2021-2022 — Beeple's $69M sale at Christie's
financial_bubbles.modern_data: NFT art market volume fell 97% from 2022 peak. Average NFT price dropped from $3.8K to $93.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Art appreciation and art speculation are different activities.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Financial fraud hidden by impressive returns
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bernie Madoff ran a $64.8B Ponzi scheme for decades. Steady 10-12% annual returns regardless of market conditions. Exposed by 2008 crisis when redemptions exceeded new investments.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + trust in authority + too-good-to-be-true blindness
financial_bubbles.outcome: Thousands of investors wiped out. Charities destroyed. Madoff sentenced to 150 years. His sons both died.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: OneCoin ($4B crypto Ponzi), BitConnect ($2.6B), numerous DeFi rug pulls
financial_bubbles.modern_data: In 2023, crypto investors lost $5.6B to rug pulls and exit scams (Chainalysis).
financial_bubbles.data_source: SEC, DOJ, Chainalysis Crypto Crime Report 2024
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Consistent high returns with no losses = mathematical impossibility = fraud.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Railroad overbuilding fueled by government subsidies
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Union Pacific Railroad executives created Credit Mobilier construction company, charging the government $94M for $50M of actual work. Shares given to congressmen to prevent investigation.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Corruption + political capture + subsidy abuse
financial_bubbles.outcome: National scandal exposed in 1872. Two congressmen censured. Public trust in government cratered.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Solyndra ($535M government loan, bankrupt), EV subsidies going to questionable companies
financial_bubbles.modern_data: US EV tax credits exceeded $7.5B in 2023. Several recipients under investigation for inflated claims.
financial_bubbles.data_source: Congressional Research Service, DOE Inspector General
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Government subsidies attract grifters as reliably as light attracts moths.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Penny stock pump and dump schemes exploit retail naivety
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Jordan Belfort's Stratton Oakmont cold-called investors to buy worthless penny stocks. Firm generated $200M in commissions. Over 1,500 accounts defrauded.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + social pressure + trust in 'expert' advice
financial_bubbles.outcome: Belfort imprisoned. $110M in restitution ordered. Pattern replicated in Wolf of Wall Street film.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Telegram/Discord pump-and-dump groups for crypto and penny stocks 2020-2024
financial_bubbles.modern_data: SEC reported 79% increase in social media-related securities fraud cases 2020-2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Unsolicited investment advice from strangers is always self-serving.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Collectible mania follows same pattern as financial bubbles
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Ty Warner created artificial scarcity by retiring models. Princess Diana bear sold for $500K. Couples listed Beanie Babies in divorce settlements. College funds redirected to collections.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Scarcity illusion + collecting mania + FOMO
financial_bubbles.outcome: Market collapsed by 2000. Collections worth thousands became worth pennies. Multiple divorces and financial ruin.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Funko Pop valuations, Pokemon card speculation 2020-2022
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Logan Paul paid $3.5M for Pokemon cards in 2021. Pokemon TCG market fell 40% by 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Manufactured scarcity creates manufactured value — which can be unmanufactured.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Mining speculation in remote locations with unverifiable claims
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bre-X Minerals claimed to have found 200M ounces of gold in Borneo — the largest deposit ever. Market cap reached $6B CAD. Geologist Michael de Guzman fell from a helicopter. Gold was salted.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Greed + trust in 'expert' verification + geographic remoteness enabling fraud
financial_bubbles.outcome: Stock went from $280 to worthless in days. Investors lost $6B. de Guzman presumed dead/suicide.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Nickel Asia fraud allegations, Lordstown Motors EV fraud
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Lordstown Motors went bankrupt in 2023. CEO charged with fraud. Pre-orders were fabricated.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: The more remote and impressive the claim, the harder it is to verify — and the more likely it's false.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Market crash triggered by automated trading systems
financial_bubbles.what_happened: On May 6, 2010, Dow Jones fell 1,000 points (9%) in minutes. Accenture stock went from $40 to $0.01. Procter & Gamble dropped 37%. Recovered most losses within 20 minutes.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Over-reliance on automation + fragility of complex systems + panic
financial_bubbles.outcome: SEC implemented circuit breakers. $1T in market value temporarily erased. Trust in market structure questioned.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Crypto flash crashes — Bitcoin dropped 87% on BitMEX in March 2020 due to cascading liquidations
financial_bubbles.modern_data: March 12, 2020 ('Black Thursday'): $1.6B in crypto liquidated in 24 hours. Bitcoin fell from $8K to $3.8K.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Automated systems amplify both speed and catastrophe.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Emerging market currency crisis follows capital flight
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Mexico devalued peso by 15% in December 1994. Capital flight accelerated. Peso fell 50% in weeks. US organized $50B bailout package.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Hot money + devaluation panic + contagion fear
financial_bubbles.outcome: Mexican GDP contracted 6.2%. 1M jobs lost. Contagion spread to Argentina, Brazil ('Tequila Effect').
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Turkey 2018 lira crisis, Argentina 2019 peso collapse
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Argentina defaulted on $65B in 2020 — largest sovereign default in history at the time.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Hot money enters fast and leaves faster.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Credit default swaps amplify systemic risk
financial_bubbles.what_happened: AIG sold $440B in credit default swaps on mortgage-backed securities. When housing collapsed, AIG couldn't pay claims. Government bailout: $182B — largest in history.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Moral hazard + too-big-to-fail + regulatory blindness
financial_bubbles.outcome: Taxpayer cost: $182B (eventually recovered). But precedent set for bailing out reckless institutions.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Crypto contagion 2022: 3AC collapse triggered cascading failures across DeFi
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Three Arrows Capital collapsed with $3.5B in claims. Triggered Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi failures.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Insurance against catastrophe is worthless when the insurer is also exposed to the catastrophe.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Stock market index mania disconnects from underlying economy
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 50 large-cap US stocks traded at PE ratios of 50-100x. Xerox, Polaroid, Avon called 'one-decision stocks' — buy and never sell. Market crashed 45% in 1973-74.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Growth worship + narrative over valuation + buy-and-hold cult
financial_bubbles.outcome: Many Nifty Fifty stocks lost 70-90%. Polaroid went bankrupt (2001). Some (Walmart, J&J) actually justified valuations.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: FAANG/Magnificent 7 concentration — top 7 stocks = 30% of S&P 500 by 2024
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Magnificent 7 contributed 60% of S&P 500 returns in 2023. PE ratios: 25-60x.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Concentration risk and narrative investing produce the same outcome every cycle.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Government bond crisis destroys conservative portfolios
financial_bubbles.what_happened: UK mini-budget triggered gilt sell-off. Pension funds using LDI (Liability-Driven Investment) faced margin calls. Bank of England emergency intervention: £65B to prevent systemic collapse.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Leverage in 'safe' assets + regulatory complacency + political recklessness
financial_bubbles.outcome: PM Truss resigned after 45 days. £30B in pension losses. Mortgages spiked. Housing market froze.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Potential US Treasury market stress from $34T national debt
financial_bubbles.modern_data: UK 30-year gilt yield jumped from 3.7% to 5.1% in days. BoE bought £65B in emergency purchases.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Even government bonds can crash. 'Risk-free' is a myth.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Leveraged buyout mania creates fragile companies
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Leveraged buyouts peaked with KKR's $25B takeover of RJR Nabisco (1988). Companies loaded with debt. Junk bond king Michael Milken imprisoned. Drexel Burnham Lambert collapsed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Financial engineering worship + debt as strategy + greed
financial_bubbles.outcome: Many LBO targets went bankrupt under debt load. Milken paid $600M fine. But LBO model persisted.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Private equity's current $3.7T in assets, loading companies with debt (Toys R Us, Sears bankrupted by PE)
financial_bubbles.modern_data: PE-backed company bankruptcies: Toys R Us ($5B debt), Sears, J.Crew, Hertz. PE firms still profited via fees.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Debt-funded acquisitions transfer risk to employees and creditors while profits go to financial engineers.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Carbon credit market manipulation
financial_bubbles.what_happened: European carbon trading market hit by €5B in VAT carousel fraud. Credits stolen via hacking (€30M from Czech registry). Market froze. Prices crashed 60%.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Market design failure + criminal exploitation + regulatory gaps
financial_bubbles.outcome: New security measures implemented. But carbon market credibility damaged for years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Voluntary carbon offset market criticized as greenwashing — JPMorgan study found 90% of offsets worthless
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Voluntary carbon market: $2B (2023). But 90%+ of rainforest carbon offsets don't represent real reductions (Guardian/Die Zeit investigation).
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Creating a market doesn't create integrity. Markets need rules AND enforcement.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Small investors wiped out in penny stock schemes repeatedly
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 200+ Chinese companies listed on US exchanges via reverse mergers. Many turned out to be fraudulent. Muddy Waters research exposed Sino-Forest ($6B fraud). Short sellers became heroes.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Yield chasing + geographic information asymmetry + due diligence failure
financial_bubbles.outcome: $34B in market value destroyed. SEC delisted dozens of companies. Short sellers earned 200-500% returns.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: SPACs merging with unverified companies 2020-2021, many now under investigation
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Over 80% of Chinese reverse merger companies faced SEC or PCAOB issues. 40+ delisted.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: If you can't visit the factory, you can't verify the company.

financial_bubbles.pattern: DeFi protocols exploited through code vulnerabilities
financial_bubbles.what_happened: DeFi protocols lost $5.8B to hacks 2020-2023. Largest: Ronin Bridge ($620M), Poly Network ($611M), Wormhole ($320M). Smart contract bugs exploited within hours of deployment.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Code-is-law ideology + speed over security + 'move fast break things' in finance
financial_bubbles.outcome: Billions lost. Some recovered. But pattern continues — new protocols launch with same vulnerabilities.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This IS ongoing — DeFi security remains fundamentally broken
financial_bubbles.modern_data: DeFi hacks 2023: $1.7B stolen. Total since 2020: $5.8B. Bridge protocols account for 50% of losses.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Replacing banks with code doesn't eliminate risk — it moves it from fraud to bugs.

financial_bubbles.pattern: National champion companies become too-big-to-fail liabilities
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Credit Suisse lost $5.5B on Archegos Capital blowup (2021). Then $10B Greensill scandal. Customer withdrawals: $120B in Q4 2022 alone. Emergency UBS acquisition at $3.2B (from $45B peak).
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Institutional hubris + risk culture failure + too many scandals to count
financial_bubbles.outcome: 167-year-old bank destroyed. 9,000 job cuts. Swiss banking reputation damaged. UBS became dangerously large.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Deutsche Bank's ongoing struggles — $16T in derivatives exposure, repeated scandals
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Credit Suisse: $45B peak market cap → $3.2B forced sale. 9,000 jobs cut. $5.5B Archegos + $10B Greensill losses.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: A culture of risk-taking eventually consumes even the most established institutions.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Commodity super-cycle creates false boom in resource-dependent economies
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Commodity prices peaked in 2011 driven by China demand. Oil: $114 to $26. Iron ore: $190 to $40. Copper: $10K to $4.3K. Resource economies (Australia, Brazil, Russia, Canada) suffered.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Extrapolation bias + resource dependency + China-centric worldview
financial_bubbles.outcome: Brazil recession. Russia recession + sanctions compound. Australia narrowly avoided recession. Mining job losses massive.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Post-2022 commodity correction after Ukraine war spike
financial_bubbles.modern_data: BHP profits fell 72% in 2015. Rio Tinto wrote off $14B. 200K+ mining jobs lost globally.
financial_bubbles.data_source: World Bank Commodity Price Data, Bloomberg
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Commodity super-cycles end. Resource-dependent economies that don't diversify get crushed.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Insurance industry crisis from concentrated catastrophic risk
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Lloyd's suffered £8B in losses 1988-1992 from asbestos claims, pollution liabilities, and natural disasters. 34,000 Names (individual investors) lost personal fortunes. Many bankrupted.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Tail risk underestimation + unlimited liability + generational time bombs
financial_bubbles.outcome: Lloyd's restructured. Individual Names replaced by corporate capital. But thousands of families destroyed.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Climate change creating uninsurable risks — 7 carriers left Florida 2022-2023
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Insured losses from natural disasters: $275B in 2022 (highest ever). Florida home insurance: +40% in 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Insurance works until the risks are too large and too correlated. Then nobody can insure anything.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Micro-lending becomes micro-predation
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis: borrowers took loans from multiple MFIs. Effective interest rates reached 100%+. Coercive collection practices led to 80+ suicides. State government banned MFI collections.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Good intentions corrupted by profit motive + regulatory vacuum + debt spiral
financial_bubbles.outcome: India's microfinance industry collapsed 50%. RBI implemented strict regulations. SKS Microfinance stock fell 90%.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Mobile lending apps in Kenya, Nigeria, Philippines charging 100%+ APR
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Mobile lending apps in Kenya charge 100-520% APR. 2.3M Kenyans blacklisted by credit bureaus from app loans.
financial_bubbles.data_source: RBI, CGAP, Financial Sector Deepening Kenya
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Financial inclusion without consumer protection creates financial exploitation.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Sovereign wealth fund mismanagement
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Malaysia's 1MDB sovereign fund had $4.5B stolen through complex laundering scheme. Money used to buy yachts, art, and fund Wolf of Wall Street movie. PM Najib convicted.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Kleptocracy + sovereign immunity + complex financial structures as camouflage
financial_bubbles.outcome: Najib sentenced to 12 years. Goldman Sachs paid $3.9B in fines. Malaysia's reputation damaged.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Ongoing sovereign fund governance concerns worldwide
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Goldman Sachs 1MDB fine: $3.9B (largest in bank's history). DOJ recovered $1.7B in assets.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Sovereign wealth funds with no oversight become sovereign theft funds.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Currency manipulation creates trade distortions
financial_bubbles.what_happened: G5 nations agreed to devalue the US dollar. Dollar fell 50% against yen in 2 years. Japan's exports became expensive, contributing to domestic asset bubble and eventual crash.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Competitive devaluation + currency war + unintended consequences
financial_bubbles.outcome: Contributed to Japan's bubble economy and subsequent 30-year stagnation.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: China's currency management, US accusations of manipulation against multiple countries
financial_bubbles.modern_data: China holds $3.2T in foreign reserves (world's largest). Yuan managed float with 2% daily band.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Currency manipulation creates short-term gains and long-term distortions.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Shadow banking creates unregulated parallel financial system
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Chinese shadow banking grew to $13T — wealth management products, trust loans, and entrusted lending outside regulated banking. Evergrande's $300B debt was partly shadow-financed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Regulatory arbitrage + yield chasing + opacity
financial_bubbles.outcome: Evergrande defaulted ($300B). Country Garden ($200B at risk). Shadow banking crackdown still ongoing.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: DeFi as crypto's shadow banking — same unregulated parallel system
financial_bubbles.modern_data: China shadow banking: peak $13T (2017). Evergrande: $300B default. Country Garden: $200B exposure.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Regulation creates shadow systems. Shadow systems create shadow risks.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Short squeeze creates temporary price dislocation
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Reddit's WallStreetBets coordinated buying of heavily shorted GameStop stock. Price went from $17 to $483 in 16 days. Melvin Capital lost 53%. Robinhood halted buying (controversy).
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Collective action + anti-establishment sentiment + short squeeze mechanics
financial_bubbles.outcome: Robinhood's IPO damaged. 'Meme stock' phenomenon born. But most retail traders lost money after peak.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Ongoing meme stock events: AMC, BBBY (bankrupt), Trump-related stocks
financial_bubbles.modern_data: GME: $17 → $483 → $20 within months. Melvin Capital: $6.8B AUM → closed. Robinhood restricted buying: $70B in trade restrictions.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Collective retail action can move markets temporarily but institutional forces always reassert.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Mining bubble in frontier regions
financial_bubbles.what_happened: 100,000 people headed to Yukon after gold discovery. Only 30,000 arrived. Only 4,000 found gold. The real money was made by suppliers: Levi Strauss sold jeans, Wells Fargo moved money.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Gold fever + survivor bias + supplier advantage
financial_bubbles.outcome: Most prospectors went broke. Suppliers built lasting businesses. Pattern repeated in every rush since.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: AI gold rush: most AI companies will fail, but GPU suppliers (Nvidia), cloud providers (AWS), and tools companies (Vercel) will profit
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Nvidia revenue: $61B (2024, +126% YoY). AWS cloud revenue: $90B. 90% of AI startups expected to fail.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: In a gold rush, sell picks and shovels.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Agricultural futures manipulation
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Two traders cornered the US onion market in 1955, buying 30M pounds of onions and futures. Then dumped everything. Onion prices fell below the cost of the bag they came in. Led to Onion Futures Act (1958).
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Market manipulation + commodity cornering + regulatory response
financial_bubbles.outcome: Onion futures trading banned — the ONLY commodity specifically banned from futures trading in US history.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Crypto market manipulation remains unregulated — same dynamics, different commodity
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Onions are still the only commodity banned from futures trading. Crypto manipulation estimated at 70%+ of trading volume.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Market manipulation in one commodity is banned. The same manipulation in crypto is celebrated.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Bond vigilantes force government policy changes
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Bond market sold off sharply in 1994 when Fed raised rates. Orange County lost $1.7B and declared bankruptcy — the largest municipal bankruptcy in US history at the time.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Interest rate risk denial + leverage in 'safe' investments + complacency
financial_bubbles.outcome: Orange County bankrupt. Robert Citron (treasurer) imprisoned. Taxpayers bore the losses.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: UK gilt crisis 2022, potential US Treasury market stress
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Orange County lost $1.7B on $20B portfolio. Leverage ratio: 2.7x. Current US Treasury market: $27T.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Even government bonds carry risk when leveraged.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Real estate bubble in developing nations
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Dubai built the world's tallest building while going bankrupt. Dubai World ($59B debt) requested debt standstill. Property prices fell 50%+. Abu Dhabi bailed out Dubai with $10B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Prestige building + debt-fueled development + oil price dependency
financial_bubbles.outcome: Dubai recovered but slowly. Nakheel (Palm Islands developer) restructured $16B in debt.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Dubai property bubble 2.0 (2023-2024) — Russians, Indians pouring money in again
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Dubai property prices: +20% in 2023. Russian buyers up 67%. Off-plan sales: 60%+ of market.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Dubai's first bubble is being repeated. Speculators have goldfish memories.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Government subsidized industry creates moral hazard
financial_bubbles.what_happened: US farm subsidies: $30B/year. 10% of farmers receive 75% of subsidies. Large agribusiness corporations are the primary beneficiaries. Small farmers get crumbs.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Lobbying + political capture + subsidy addiction
financial_bubbles.outcome: Subsidy system distorts global food markets. Developing country farmers can't compete. Obesity epidemic partly subsidized.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Tech company subsidies, EV subsidies — same concentration of benefits
financial_bubbles.modern_data: US farm subsidies: $30B/year. Top 10% receive 75%. Corn subsidies encourage high-fructose corn syrup production.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Subsidies designed for small farmers always end up benefiting large corporations.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Central bank creates moral hazard through repeated bailouts
financial_bubbles.what_happened: After 1987 crash, Fed signaled it would cut rates during market stress. Pattern repeated: 1998 LTCM, 2001 dot-com, 2008 GFC, 2020 COVID. Markets learned: take risk, Fed will bail you out.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Moral hazard + asymmetric risk + socialized losses/privatized gains
financial_bubbles.outcome: Risk-taking increased each cycle. Each bailout larger than the last. $4.5T in Fed purchases in 2020 alone.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This IS the ongoing pattern — will AI bubble get the same treatment?
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Fed balance sheet: $900B (2007) → $9T (2022). Each crisis: bigger bailout. 2020 QE: $4.5T in one year.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When you insure against risk, you get more risk.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Tech IPO window creates artificial urgency
financial_bubbles.what_happened: WeWork valued at $47B by SoftBank. Filed for IPO revealing $1.9B loss on $1.8B revenue. Adam Neumann's self-dealing exposed. IPO withdrawn. Valuation crashed to $9B.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Charismatic founder worship + VC echo chamber + valuation theater
financial_bubbles.outcome: Neumann received $1.7B exit package. WeWork eventually went public at $9B, then bankrupt in 2023.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Same dynamic with many unicorns: overvalued by VCs, reality check at IPO
financial_bubbles.modern_data: WeWork: $47B → $0 (bankrupt Nov 2023). Neumann personally received $1.7B. Employees lost jobs and equity.
financial_bubbles.data_source: SEC S-1 filing, WeWork bankruptcy filing
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: A charismatic founder with a PowerPoint is not a business model.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Crypto stablecoin depegging causes systemic panic
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Terra's algorithmic stablecoin UST depegged from $1. Luna went from $119 to $0.00001 in 5 days. $60B in value destroyed. Triggered cascade: 3AC, Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi all collapsed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Mathematical faith + 20% yield greed + systemic contagion
financial_bubbles.outcome: $60B destroyed in weeks. Do Kwon arrested. 3AC founders in hiding. Crypto market lost $1T.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This WAS the contagion event — similar to LTCM 1998 or Lehman 2008 for crypto
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Terra/Luna: $60B → $0 in 5 days. Anchor Protocol 20% yield on UST attracted $17B. Cascade: $1T total crypto losses.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: When someone offers you 20% 'risk-free' yield, the risk is your entire principal.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Real estate investment trust overexpansion
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Post-COVID remote work left 20% of US office space vacant. $1.5T in commercial real estate loans maturing 2024-2025. Many buildings worth less than their mortgage. Regional banks heavily exposed.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Structural change denial + loan maturity wall + extend-and-pretend
financial_bubbles.outcome: Office vacancy: 20%+ nationally, 30%+ in some cities. Values down 25-40%. Banking stress emerging.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: This IS the current crisis — unfolding in slow motion
financial_bubbles.modern_data: US office vacancy: 20%+ (2024). CRE loans maturing: $1.5T (2024-2025). Office values down 25-40% from peak.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Remote work changed everything. Commercial real estate values haven't caught up to reality yet.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Market bubble in collectible assets
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Rudy Kurniawan sold $35M in counterfeit wine — mixing cheap wine and relabeling as rare vintages. Fooled expert collectors for years. First person convicted of wine fraud in US.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Snob value + authentication difficulty + trust exploitation
financial_bubbles.outcome: Kurniawan sentenced to 10 years. But wine fraud estimated at 5% of fine wine market ($10B+).
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: NFT art fraud — impossible to verify provenance of digital assets
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Fine wine fraud: 5% of $300B+ market. Wine Authentication: only 3 labs worldwide can definitively authenticate. NFT fraud: $100M+ in 2023.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: The harder it is to authenticate, the easier it is to fake.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Infrastructure privatization enriches investors at public expense
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Chicago sold 75-year parking meter lease for $1.15B. Within 5 years, estimated value was $5B+. City locked out of adjusting parking policy for 75 years.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Short-term political thinking + privatization ideology + irreversible commitments
financial_bubbles.outcome: Investors (Morgan Stanley consortium) earning $134M/year. City lost control of public infrastructure for 75 years.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Toll road privatizations, water system privatizations — same pattern globally
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Chicago meters: $1.15B sale, $5B+ true value. Annual revenue to investors: $134M. City can't even close a street without paying.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: Privatizing public assets for short-term budget relief costs the public far more in the long run.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Crypto lending platform collapse
financial_bubbles.what_happened: Celsius offered 18% APY on crypto deposits. Lent customer funds in risky DeFi protocols. When markets crashed, couldn't honor withdrawals. Froze $4.7B in customer funds.
financial_bubbles.human_nature_at_play: Yield chasing + custodial risk + too-good-to-be-true yields
financial_bubbles.outcome: $4.7B frozen. CEO Alex Mashinsky arrested for fraud. Customers recovered ~60%.
financial_bubbles.modern_parallel: Ongoing crypto lending regulation debate
financial_bubbles.modern_data: Celsius: $4.7B frozen. 18% APY was unsustainable. Mashinsky personally profited $48M.
financial_bubbles.lesson_ignored: If the yield seems impossible, the risk is your entire deposit.

financial_bubbles.pattern: Stock market crash from margin calls
